methodology: დეტერმინისტული synthetic binary64 cancellation fixture და exact-rational reference
contiguous/round-robin partition-ები, 1/2/4/8 worker-ები და naive/scalar Neumaier/compensation-state მეთოდები

One warm-up and five timed repetitions per case; record actual native thread counts, monotonic wall time, process CPU time, process peak RSS and compiler/runtime provenance

Independent MPFR 4.2.1 oracle: represent the exact signed integer in 2,624-bit precision, divide by 2^1074 exactly, then convert with MPFR_RNDN; compare bit patterns against the C converter and Python Decimal on hosted x86-64 and ARM64. The native workflow asserts pkg-config reports MPFR 4.2.1.

Download the original GIL-enabled and free-threaded Actions artifact ZIPs, verify archive SHA-256 against the frozen summary, and independently recompute per-case accuracy and worker-count metric aggregates.

streams.status_detail: PR #63 merged into main as c89725743a98252da0bfba1ce0bb51472f758e44. Its exact-head quality CI 45841469603, GIL-enabled/free-threaded CPU-thread workflow 45841469605 and native MPFR 4.2.1 x86-64/ARM64 workflow 45841469616 all succeeded. The full-width/tie-adjacent suite matched MPFR_RNDN, Python integer and Decimal references for 2,068/2,068 deterministic inputs on each hosted architecture. The actual-thread experiment recorded 48/48 correct runs for preserved Neumaier (sum, correction) state, 42/48 for scalarized Neumaier and 0/48 for naive partial sums; threaded wall-time speedup remained below 1 on the synthetic workload. Main post-merge quality CI 45842391678, native x86-64/ARM64 workflow 45842391826 and Pages build/deploy 45842391666 succeeded. This is hosted reproducible software evidence, not formal proof or independent physical-hardware replication; representative scientific workloads and independent numerical review remain outstanding. The study remains preliminary. A post-hoc independent provenance audit downloaded both original workflow ZIP artifacts and recomputed SHA-256 over the archive bytes: GIL-enabled 99e8f5970a73d55dcf6dff0aa3c37dc44312b0112add16404f303343af30775c (7,620 bytes) and free-threaded 95e5d83563404c1e0de979991e5b71bd852f43af9c3ee05d0e5c8f6475a7fcd9 (7,830 bytes). Both matched the frozen summary; reaggregation of the raw 48-case JSON reports reproduced the stored accuracy counts and metric ranges. This verifies artifact integrity and summary arithmetic, not a second benchmark execution. PR #66 merged into main as 45f9511ca1552a9ef680b7d52a3d560bc858a485. Exact-head quality CI 45844362485 passed 334 tests and CPU-thread workflow 45844363177 passed both runtime jobs; post-merge main quality CI 45844512093 passed 334 tests and Pages build/deploy 45844512448 succeeded.
streams.next_step: Obtain independent numerical-method review of the checked signed accumulator and MPFR converter; then evaluate pairwise, Neumaier, long-double and exact methods on representative memory-bandwidth-bound workloads and repeat on independently selected physical x86-64/ARM64 systems with uncertainty intervals.

streams.status_detail: PR #62 merged the UNDRR MHEWS 2026 country-level snapshot and arithmetic. PR #68 merged as f12a116c86514994ec40c4a953ba6a4f0a4656fc; exact-head quality CI 45849048113 succeeded. The new WMO 2026 roadmap snapshot reproduces 20/35 = 57.1429% of 35 government-validated roadmaps with clear budget allocations and approximately USD 69 million mean among those 20. An aggregate-only action-readiness validator and strict schema now keep endpoint receipts separate from survey-based receipt, comprehension, feasible action, self-reported action and verified action. Synthetic tests only; no field data, local effectiveness measurement or causal claim. Post-merge main CI 45850024686 passed 354 tests and Pages build/deploy 45850024682 succeeded.
streams.next_step: Seek the official Georgia basin/municipal data dictionary and explicit permission for aggregate event-level warning and after-action data; obtain local privacy review of the proposed small-cell rule before any pilot, then pre-register comprehension, feasible-action and verified-action denominators.

streams.title: კვლევითი პლატფორმის სანდოობა, provenance და backup/restore
streams.problem: კვლევითი ჩანაწერების, job queue-ისა და audit trail-ის სანდოობა დამოკიდებულია მიკვლევადობაზე, უსაფრთხო backup-ზე და რეალურად შემოწმებულ restore-ზე; backup-ის წარმატებული შექმნა თავისთავად აღდგენადობას არ ადასტურებს.
streams.research_question: შეუძლია თუ არა NOEMA-ს local SQLite runtime-ს შექმნას თვითმყოფადი, integrity-შემოწმებული backup და უსაფრთხოდ აღადგინოს ის ისე, რომ WAL-only state, audit tampering ან არსებული database-ის overwrite არ მოხდეს?
streams.human_benefit: კვლევის ისტორიისა და სამუშაოების დაკარგვის რისკის შემცირება და შედეგების წარმომავლობის შენარჩუნება.
streams.hypothesis: SQLite file header-ის journal-version-ის პირდაპირი შემოწმება immutable read-only validation-თან ერთად სწორად უარყოფს WAL-mode backup-ს ისე, რომ source file არ შეიცვალოს.
methodology: SQLite official file-format და WAL documentation-ის მიხედვით file header-ის byte 18/19 შემოწმება
synthetic database backup/restore round-trip, WAL-mode negative case, tampered audit და no-overwrite regression tests
GitHub Actions-ის exact-head CI და mergeability verification
შემდგომ ეტაპზე encrypted off-host backup, retention/rotation და scheduled restore drills
On POSIX, stage each local SQLite snapshot in a fresh 0700 directory with a 0600 temporary database file; verify both permissions at the atomic no-overwrite publication boundary.

The restore-drill CLI requires an existing database, verifies it, creates an online SQLite snapshot and restores it into a second new path inside a temporary directory; it compares job/audit counts and the final audit-chain hash, confirms the backup bytes remain unchanged, and emits aggregate-only JSON without job IDs or payloads.
Define a strict JSON Schema 2020-12 metadata envelope for future off-host backups; tests enforce closed object boundaries and exclude secret/credential fields.
Validate proposed backup manifests with an executable JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validator and strict format checking; keep cryptographic and provider checks explicitly out of scope.

data_needs: synthetic SQLite databases with rollback-journal and WAL header states
backup/restore test fixtures and immutable source hash
CI job logs and exact commit SHA
Operator-approved non-production database for a real restore drill; record elapsed time and aggregate recovery evidence only.
risks: immutable=1 SQLite connection may mask the stored WAL journal mode
same-host backup does not protect against host/disk loss
backup is currently unencrypted and has no off-host retention automation
audit hash chain without signed external checkpoint does not prevent all tampering scenarios
Private staging-directory permissions are POSIX-specific; the final backup remains subject to the destination parent's ACL and can be exposed if that parent is too permissive.

The restore-drill CLI validates a same-host temporary filesystem round-trip only; it does not validate encrypted off-host storage, provider object versions, key recovery or clean-host disaster recovery.
blockers: Encrypted off-host storage, signed manifest, provider integration, key custody, retention/rotation and an approved RPO/RTO remain unimplemented; the new CLI drill is same-host only and has not yet been run against an operator-approved deployed/staging database.
streams.status_detail: PR #57 same-host SQLite backup/restore drill and PR #64 strict non-secret Draft 2020-12 metadata schema remain in main. PR #69 merged as 990ba166c7422257291ba2abfc9278ea7099c654; exact-head CI 45849597538 passed the runtime schema validator and full 341-test suite. Main quality CI 45850024686 passed 354 tests and Pages build/deploy 45850024682 succeeded. The runtime validator rejects malformed hashes/timestamps, missing fields and credential-like extras, but it does not verify signatures, decrypt or hash ciphertext, inspect SQLite, prove provider retention or establish clean-host recovery.
streams.next_step: Implement an isolated encrypted off-host proof-of-concept only after provider, key custody, RPO/RTO and retention are approved; then test detached signature verification, ciphertext/plaintext hash comparison and clean-host restore with separate credentials.
success_metrics: backup includes committed WAL data
restore rejects WAL-mode header and corrupted audit data before destination creation
restore never overwrites an existing destination and does not mutate source bytes
complete unit tests, frozen research reproductions, site build and publication-boundary checks pass
restore drill and encrypted off-host backup policy are documented and later independently tested
On POSIX, a test observes the staging directory at 0700 and the SQLite snapshot at 0600 immediately before no-overwrite publication, even when the destination parent is 0777.
restore-drill returns success only when source and restored databases are valid, job/audit counts and final audit hash match, and the backup bytes remain unchanged
restore-drill output contains aggregate metadata only and explicitly identifies the same-host-only evidence boundary
The future manifest is structurally validated against a strict schema; every object rejects unlisted fields and no secret/private-key material is permitted.
Runtime manifest validator accepts a synthetic schema-valid document and rejects malformed hashes, invalid UTC timestamps, missing fields and secret-like extra properties.
No claim of off-host disaster-recovery readiness until a clean-host restore is independently attested against approved RPO/RTO.
